purpose: Ask for one short piece of writing under a list of constraints that a rule-based scorer can check exactly, so instruction following is measured without any judgement.
system: Follow every constraint exactly. Output only what is asked for, with no preamble, no explanation and no commentary about the constraints themselves.

task.description: The single piece of writing being asked for, stated in one sentence.

constraints.description: The constraints as a newline-separated list, rendered from the case's own machine-checkable constraint declarations so the text a model reads and the rules the scorer applies cannot drift apart.

expectations: Plain text obeying every listed constraint, and nothing else.

metadata.author: suite
metadata.change_reason: First version: native.instruction_following needs one prompt whose constraint text is rendered from the same declaration the rule scorer checks.
